answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, yet correlated equivocation is detected through shared signing patterns and incurs a quadratic penalty: a coordinated set of k identities loses O(k^2) collateral, not k times one fine. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake, making a sybil swarm economically brittle. A pulse of coordinated fraud may glitter like crystal or opal, but recovery value collapses.
